title: Quavers
summary: Split the beat in two and tap pairs of quavers joined by a beam.
usSummary: Split the beat in two and tap pairs of eighth notes joined by a beam.

hook.text: Walk to the shops: walk, walk, walk, walk. Now run for the bus: run-ning, run-ning, run-ning, run-ning. Same pulse, but two sounds in every step. Press play to hear a tune that does both. Where does it start to run?

explore.text: Your turn. First tap once on every click, like steady footsteps. Then tap twice for every click: once on the click and once halfway to the next, like "run-ning". Then mix the two.
explore.goal: Tap the steady beats, then the fast taps, then the mix of both.

cards.text: One [[quaver|quaver]] lasts half a beat. It has a filled-in head and a stem with one hook. Two [[quaver|quavers]] fit into 1 beat, the time of one [[crotchet|crotchet]]. Say "run-ning" for two [[quaver|quavers]].

[[quaver|Quavers]] that sit side by side are joined by a [[beam|beam]]: a thick line in place of the little hooks. A single [[quaver|quaver]] keeps its hook. Here, 8 [[quaver|quavers]] are joined into two groups.
To count [[quaver|quavers]], say "and" halfway between the numbers: 1-and-2-and-3-and-4-and. Each number is on a beat. Each "and" is the second [[quaver|quaver]] of that beat.

alternative.text: Cut a [[crotchet|crotchet]] in half and you get 2 [[quaver|quavers]]. Cut a [[minim|minim]] and you get 4. Cut a [[semibreve|semibreve]] and you get 8. The cuts change the notes, never the time. The two [[bar|bars]] below last exactly the same.

points: One [[quaver|quaver]] has a filled-in head and a stem with one hook. It lasts half a beat.
Two [[quaver|quavers]] last 1 beat, as long as one [[crotchet|crotchet]]: "run-ning" is two [[quaver|quavers]].
A [[beam|beam]] joins [[quaver|quavers]] that sit together. Count them 1-and-2-and-3-and-4-and.
